t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use the 1x rounds to figure out which gnomes are giving more mushrooms, so that you know which gnomes to pick to maximize your mushrooms in the 5x rounds. The values can change throughout the game, so sometimes use the 1x rounds to experiment with picking a different color gnome, in case their value has improved.

vb_textbox.text: The mushroom amounts will spontaneously change throughout the game. The biggest changes tend to happen between the optional 5 minute breaks, but the values can also randomly change within the same round. I found that they didn't fluctuate that much within the same round, so sticking with what is working probably isn't a bad idea. Though, if you do want to test whether or not a previously lower value color has changed, make sure to do it on the 1x rounds, since if you are wrong, you won't lose out on as many mushrooms.
